017package org.apache.juneau.examples.mcp;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728.*;
022import org.apache.juneau.commons.inject.*;
023import org.apache.juneau.marshall.json.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.marshall.sse.*;
025import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.*;
027import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728.*;
028
029/**
030 * A complete, runnable MCP <c>2026-07-28</c> server exposing every major surface of the protocol
031 * over one tiny, coherent scenario: an in-memory {@link NoteStore notes} service.
032 *
033 * <p>
034 * This is the reference implementation to copy. Everything the server exposes is registered in
035 * {@link #createMcpConfig()} below, and every handler is a small anonymous class that closes over a
036 * single shared {@link NoteStore}. What each surface demonstrates:
037 *
038 * <ul>
039 *    <li><b>tool</b> &mdash; {@code publishNote(title, body)} stores a note and then <i>pushes</i> a
040 *       {@code resources/updated} change to any subscribers (see the subscription bullet).
041 *    <li><b>tool + elicitation / MRTR</b> &mdash; {@code deleteNote(title)} returns an
042 *       {@code input_required} pause asking the caller to confirm, then resumes to actually delete.
043 *       This is one of the framework's two headline features.
044 *    <li><b>prompt + completion</b> &mdash; {@code summarize} renders a prompt message from a stored
045 *       note; its {@code title} argument offers {@code completion/complete} suggestions from existing
046 *       note titles.
047 *    <li><b>resource</b> &mdash; the fixed {@code note:///index} resource lists all note titles.
048 *    <li><b>resource template + completion</b> &mdash; {@code note:///{title}} reads one note by title;
049 *       its {@code title} variable also offers completions.
050 *    <li><b>subscription</b> &mdash; {@code subscriptions/listen} (SEP-2575 held-open SSE) delivers the
051 *       {@code resources/updated} change {@code publishNote} fires. The other headline feature.
052 * </ul>
053 *
054 * <p>
055 * The two overridable factory hooks are the whole story:
056 * <ul>
057 *    <li>{@link #createMcpConfig()} &mdash; <i>what</i> the server exposes (tools/prompts/resources).
058 *    <li>{@link #createMcpOptions()} &mdash; <i>how</i> it behaves (advertised capabilities, etc.).
059 * </ul>
060 *
061 * <p>
062 * The {@link Rest @Rest} annotation must register {@link SseSerializer} (alongside the JSON
063 * serializer) so a real servlet container can satisfy the {@code Accept: text/event-stream}
064 * negotiation the subscription stream requires; the base {@link McpRestServlet} wires only JSON.
065 *
066 * @serial exclude
067 */
068@Rest(serializers = {JsonSerializer.class, SseSerializer.class}, parsers = JsonParser.class, defaultAccept = "application/json")
069@SuppressWarnings({
070   "java:S110" // Inheritance depth is inherent to extending the Juneau REST server hierarchy.
071})
072public class ExampleMcpServer extends McpRestServlet {
073
074   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
075
076   /** The {@code title} argument/variable name shared by the tools, prompt, and resource template below. */
077   private static final String TITLE_ARG = "title";
078
079   /** The MIME type of every note resource this server serves. */
080   private static final String TEXT_PLAIN = "text/plain";
081
082   /** Prefix of the {@code deleteNote} MRTR continuation token, encoding the note title being deleted. */
083   private static final String DELETE_CONTINUATION_PREFIX = "delete:";
084
085   // The entire domain state. Handlers below close over this instance, so there is no DI ceremony to
086   // follow: the server object owns its notes, and every MCP surface is a thin view over them.
087   private final transient NoteStore notes = new NoteStore();
088
089   /**
090    * Declares everything this server exposes. This one method is the "table of contents" for the demo.
091    */
092   @Override
093   protected McpServerConfig createMcpConfig() {
094      return new McpServerConfig()
095         .setName("juneau-notes-example")
096         .setVersion("1.0.0")
097         .addTool(publishNoteTool(notes))
098         .addTool(deleteNoteTool(notes))
099         .addPrompt(summarizePrompt(notes))
100         .addResource(noteIndexResource(notes))
101         .addResourceTemplate(noteTemplate(notes));
102   }
103
104   /**
105    * Advertises capabilities and instructions. Explicit here so the {@code server/discover} handshake
106    * truthfully reports everything this server supports &mdash; notably {@code resources.subscribe},
107    * which pairs with the {@code subscriptions/listen} demo.
108    *
109    * <p>
110    * On revision {@code 2026-07-28}, {@code server/discover}'s {@code instructions} field is sourced from
111    * this {@link McpOptions}, <b>not</b> {@link McpServerConfig#setInstructions}, which only feeds the
112    * legacy v1 {@code initialize} handshake.
113    */
114   @Override
115   protected McpOptions createMcpOptions() {
116      return new McpOptions()
117         .setInstructions("A tiny notes service. Use 'publishNote' to add notes, read them via the "
118            + "'note:///{title}' resource template, subscribe for change notifications, and try "
119            + "'deleteNote' to see an elicitation (confirm) round-trip.")
120         .setCapabilities(new ServerCapabilities()
121            .setTools(new ToolCapability().setListChanged(true))
122            .setPrompts(new PromptCapability().setListChanged(true))
123            .setResources(new ResourceCapability().setSubscribe(true).setListChanged(true))
124            .setCompletions(new CompletionCapability()));
125   }
126
127   // =================================================================================================
128   // Tools
129   // =================================================================================================
130
131   /**
132    * A plain tool that mutates server state and then notifies subscribers.
133    *
134    * <p>
135    * The {@code resourceUpdated(...)} call is the server-push half of the subscription feature: any client
136    * currently {@code listen}ing for changes to this note's URI receives an {@code onResourceUpdated} frame.
137    * The {@link McpSubscriptions} SPI is resolved from the per-request {@link BeanStore}.
138    */
139   private static McpToolHandler publishNoteTool(NoteStore notes) {
140      return new McpToolHandler() {
141         @Override public McpToolSpec descriptor() {
142            return new McpToolSpec().setName("publishNote")
143               .setDescription("Stores a note under the given title and notifies subscribers of the change.");
144         }
145         @Override public McpToolOutcome call(Map<String,Object> arguments, BeanStore ctx) {
146            var title = String.valueOf(arguments.getOrDefault(TITLE_ARG, ""));
147            var body = String.valueOf(arguments.getOrDefault("body", ""));
148            notes.put(title, body);
149            ctx.getBean(McpSubscriptions.class).ifPresent(s -> s.resourceUpdated(NoteStore.uriFor(title)));
150            return McpToolOutcome.text("Stored note '" + title + "' (" + body.length() + " chars).");
151         }
152      };
153   }
154
155   /**
156    * A tool that pauses for confirmation before acting &mdash; the elicitation / Multi-Round-Trip-Request
157    * (MRTR, SEP-2322) flow.
158    *
159    * <p>
160    * On the first call there is no resume context, so the handler <i>throws</i> an {@code input_required}
161    * signal built by {@link ElicitationRequests#of(String, ElicitRequest, Object)}: it carries one question
162    * (id {@code "confirmDelete"}, asking for a boolean {@code confirm} field) plus a continuation token
163    * ({@code "delete:<title>"}) that the framework seals and echoes back. The id and the field name are
164    * deliberately distinct (rather than both {@code "confirm"}) so the two-level {@code (id, field)} lookup
165    * below is legible. When the client answers, the framework re-invokes this same handler with a populated
166    * {@link McpMrtrResumeContext}; the handler reads the answer and the continuation and finishes.
167    *
168    * <p>
169    * Note the title is recovered from the continuation on resume rather than from the arguments: carrying
170    * per-pause state through the continuation is the intended MRTR pattern.
171    *
172    * <p>
173    * The framework explicitly allows a resume with zero elicitation answers (a client that never asked the
174    * user, or a transport that dropped the answer), so the continuation and the {@code confirm} answer are
175    * both treated as possibly missing below &mdash; never dereferenced directly. {@link McpMrtrResumeContext#continuationAsString()}
176    * and {@link ElicitationResponses#getBoolean} are the decline/omission-safe accessors that make that
177    * possible without hand-rolled null checks.
178    */
179   private static McpToolHandler deleteNoteTool(NoteStore notes) {
180      return new McpToolHandler() {
181         @Override public McpToolSpec descriptor() {
182            return new McpToolSpec().setName("deleteNote")
183               .setDescription("Deletes a note, after asking the caller to confirm (demonstrates elicitation).");
184         }
185         @Override public McpToolOutcome call(Map<String,Object> arguments, BeanStore ctx) {
186            var resume = ctx.getBean(McpMrtrResumeContext.class);
187            if (resume.isEmpty()) {
188               // PAUSE: ask the caller to confirm. Execution stops here and control returns to the client.
189               var title = String.valueOf(arguments.getOrDefault(TITLE_ARG, ""));
190               var question = new ElicitRequest()
191                  .setMessage("Really delete note '" + title + "'?")
192                  .setRequestedSchema(ElicitSchema.create().booleanField("confirm").title("Confirm deletion").build());
193               throw ElicitationRequests.of("confirmDelete", question, DELETE_CONTINUATION_PREFIX + title);
194            }
195            // RESUME: the caller answered (or didn't). Recover state from the continuation; a missing
196            // continuation or a missing/declined "confirm" answer both cleanly mean "cancelled".
197            var rc = resume.get();
198            var continuation = rc.continuationAsString();
199            var title = continuation != null && continuation.startsWith(DELETE_CONTINUATION_PREFIX)
200               ? continuation.substring(DELETE_CONTINUATION_PREFIX.length()) : "";
201            if (ElicitationResponses.getBoolean(rc, "confirmDelete", "confirm")) {
202               var removed = notes.remove(title);
203               return McpToolOutcome.text(removed
204                  ? "Deleted note '" + title + "'."
205                  : "There was no note titled '" + title + "'.");
206            }
207            return McpToolOutcome.text("Deletion of '" + title + "' was cancelled.");
208         }
209      };
210   }
211
212   // =================================================================================================
213   // Prompt
214   // =================================================================================================
215
216   /**
217    * A prompt whose {@code title} argument declares a completer, so a client's {@code completion/complete}
218    * request for that argument is answered with matching existing note titles.
219    */
220   private static McpPromptHandler summarizePrompt(NoteStore notes) {
221      var spec = new McpPromptSpec()
222         .setName("summarize")
223         .setDescription("Builds a prompt asking a model to summarize a stored note.")
224         .setArguments(List.of(new McpPromptArgument()
225            .setName(TITLE_ARG)
226            .setDescription("The title of the note to summarize.")
227            .setRequired(true)
228            .setCompleter(noteTitleCompleter(notes))));
229      return new McpPromptHandler() {
230         @Override public McpPromptSpec descriptor() { return spec; }
231         @Override public McpPromptOutcome get(Map<String,Object> arguments, BeanStore ctx) {
232            var title = String.valueOf(arguments.getOrDefault(TITLE_ARG, ""));
233            var body = notes.get(title);
234            var text = body == null
235               ? "There is no note titled '" + title + "'."
236               : "Summarize the following note titled '" + title + "':\n\n" + body;
237            var message = new McpPromptMessage().setRole(McpRole.USER).setContent(McpContentBlock.text(text));
238            return new McpPromptOutcome()
239               .setDescription("Summary prompt for note '" + title + "'.")
240               .setMessages(List.of(message));
241         }
242      };
243   }
244
245   // =================================================================================================
246   // Resources
247   // =================================================================================================
248
249   /**
250    * A fixed (non-templated) resource that lists all current note titles.
251    */
252   private static McpResourceHandler noteIndexResource(NoteStore notes) {
253      var spec = new McpResourceSpec()
254         .setUri(NoteStore.SCHEME + "index")
255         .setName("note-index")
256         .setDescription("A plain-text list of all note titles.")
257         .setMimeType(TEXT_PLAIN);
258      return new McpResourceHandler() {
259         @Override public McpResourceSpec descriptor() { return spec; }
260         @Override public McpResourceOutcome read(String uri, BeanStore ctx) {
261            var titles = notes.titles();
262            var text = titles.isEmpty() ? "(no notes yet)" : String.join("\n", titles);
263            return new McpResourceOutcome().setContents(List.of(McpResourceContents.text(uri, TEXT_PLAIN, text)));
264         }
265      };
266   }
267
268   /**
269    * A resource template ({@code note:///{title}}) that reads one note by title, and offers completions
270    * for its {@code title} variable.
271    *
272    * <p>
273    * An exact resource registration (here, {@code note:///index}) always beats a matching template, so
274    * {@code note:///index} reads the index above while {@code note:///groceries} routes here.
275    */
276   private static McpResourceTemplateHandler noteTemplate(NoteStore notes) {
277      var spec = new McpResourceTemplateSpec()
278         .setUriTemplate(NoteStore.SCHEME + "{title}")
279         .setName("note")
280         .setDescription("Reads a single note by title.")
281         .setMimeType(TEXT_PLAIN);
282      var completer = noteTitleCompleter(notes);
283      return new McpResourceTemplateHandler() {
284         @Override public McpResourceTemplateSpec descriptor() { return spec; }
285         @Override public McpResourceOutcome read(String uri, Map<String,String> variables, BeanStore ctx) {
286            var title = variables.get(TITLE_ARG);
287            var body = notes.get(title);
288            var text = body == null ? "(no note titled '" + title + "')" : body;
289            return new McpResourceOutcome().setContents(List.of(McpResourceContents.text(uri, TEXT_PLAIN, text)));
290         }
291         @Override public McpCompleter completer(String variableName) {
292            return TITLE_ARG.equals(variableName) ? completer : null;
293         }
294      };
295   }
296
297   // =================================================================================================
298   // Shared completion logic
299   // =================================================================================================
300
301   /**
302    * A completer that suggests existing note titles beginning with the caller's partial input. Used by both
303    * the prompt argument and the resource-template variable, so one implementation drives every
304    * {@code completion/complete} response in this server.
305    */
306   private static McpCompleter noteTitleCompleter(NoteStore notes) {
307      return (request, ctx) -> {
308         var prefix = request.getValue();
309         var matches = notes.titles().stream().filter(t -> t.startsWith(prefix)).toList();
310         return new McpCompletionResult().setValues(matches);
311      };
312   }
313}
